messages:
Nina (CSM): Heads-up: Sequoia private deploy cutover scheduled tomorrow 01:00-02:00 UTC. Need final signoff on network egress, IAM audit role trust, KMS HSM policy, and audit-log retention. No data-plane downtime expected.
Ravi (Infra): Quick check 1: are we running the log-forwarder inside customer VPC and sending to their SIEM via peering? That affects proxy/SNI and firewall entries.
Jules (Network): Yes, log-forwarder in VPC -> private link -> collector. Firewall only needs tcp/443 to 10.60.90.0/24 and SNI allowlist for siem.sequoia.local.
Sofia (Customer): Our proxy team requires the collector hostname plus cert thumbprint. I'll DM the thumbprint and open a proxy ticket now.
Ravi (Infra): Also, customer legal requested one minor edit in the KMS policy (support access clause). We can update and re-issue the policy PDF for signature. Recommend explicit rotation during cutover to capture rotation ARN.
Nina (CSM): Important: if signed key policy isn't in by T-48h this becomes a schedule risk tied to their renewal milestone. Flagging renewal-risk:keypolicy.
Sofia (Customer): Understood. Pushing legal now. I expect the signed policy today; if not, we accept a 24h delay.
Jules (Network): Staging ACL validated. I'll stage prod change and flip it during the window after we have the signed policy and thumbprint.
AuditBot: Dry-run canary completed: commit f1b2 -> staging. Sample audit events visible: https://logs.redwood/canary/f1b2
Ravi (Infra): Canary shows events forwarded correctly. If prod forwarder fails we fall back to local S3 snapshot and revert network changes (runbook step 6).
Nina (CSM): Actions: 1) Sofia to DM cert thumbprint + proxy ticket (today). 2) Legal to sign KMS policy (T-48h) or delay. 3) Jules to apply prod ACL in-window. 4) Ravi to rotate CMK during cutover and capture audit entry. 5) AuditBot to run final dry-run 1h before window.
Sofia (Customer): Thumbprint and proxy ticket posted. Legal signs incoming. SOC will monitor cutover. Will update here if anything blocks.
